name: Podkidnoy Durak (Durak Podkidnoy)
description: Podkidnoy Durak (historically translated as 'Throw-in Fool') is the most popular and strategically intense variant of the traditional Russian game Durak. Unlike the basic variant where an attack consists of a single card, Podkidnoy allows all other players to 'Throw In' cards that match the rank of any attacking or defending card on the table. It is a game of shifting alliances, brutal resource management, and the unique goal of simply NOT being the loser.
tagline: Attack-defend shedding with throw-ins; last player with cards loses (the Durak).

content.text: Podkidnoy Durak (historically translated as 'Throw-in Fool') is the most popular and strategically intense variant of the traditional Russian game Durak. Unlike the basic variant where an attack consists of a single card, Podkidnoy allows all other players to 'Throw In' cards that match the rank of any attacking or defending card on the table. It is a game of shifting alliances, brutal resource management, and the unique goal of simply NOT being the loser.

Durak emerged in the late 18th century as a 'Commoners' game' in imperial Russia. The 'Podkidnoy' variant was popularized in the Soviet era, becoming the definitive version played in schools, trains, and at home.
Each player receives 6 cards. The next card is placed face-up under the deck to set TRUMP. This card is the last one to be drawn.

items.text: Duraka uchat / Is pod duraka: Who attacks first after the fool deals: Duraka uchat (fool is taught) means the player to the right of the dealer attacks first; Is pod duraka (we go from under the fool) means the player to the left of the dealer attacks first.
Trump 6 exchange: Some players do not allow the trump 6 to be exchanged for the face-up trump; some allow exchange for the ace only.
52-card pack for 5-6 players: When five or six play, a full 52-card pack may be used; the two of trumps (instead of the six) can then be exchanged for the face-up trump. Rare variation.
